page.overview:
Who is Alec's Family?

Alec's Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Alec from Lonely Freddy, the second story of Fazbear Frights 2: Fetch.

Alec is the protagonist of the second Fazbear Frights book's second story.

Ian is Alec and Hazel's father. He named Alec as a combination of "Eric" and the name Meg wanted. "Alexander." When Hazel was born, he and Meg began scolding Alec more and constantly praised Hazel. Ian joined Meg as she used The Growing Child to come up with exercises the mold Alec's behavior. They try having Alec name himself, have him plant a garden, and try having a family camping trip, but all three end in disaster. Ian loses faith in the books as Meg moves on to a new one called The Plan Planner. A week before Hazel's tenth birthday party, Meg tells Ian about a plan created using Chapter Five. Ian expresses his confusion over the multiple books and his little faith in them, but Meg asks if he has an alternative ideas. Not ready to give up, he goes along with the plan.

The next day, Ian and Meg constantly scold Alec in order to get him to behave better. However, Hazel begins to act worse, "accidentally" dropping Ian's shirts in the mud and talking back against Meg during dinner. The following day, when Ian tries to scold Alec for scratching the side of his car with his bike, Hazel unapologetically takes the blame instead. After dinner, Ian and Meg try to discuss Hazel's shift in behavior, but when asked if Meg looks haggard Ian doesn't refute the claim. Meg gets upset as Ian tries bringing the topic back to their kids, but Meg insults his parenting and starts an argument between them.
